CREATE TABLE users (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  auth_subject text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  display_name text NOT NULL,
  paper_cash numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (paper_cash >= 0),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE captain_profiles (
  user_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id),
  handle text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  bio text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE instruments (
  id text PRIMARY KEY,
  symbol text NOT NULL,
  mint_address text,
  decimals smallint NOT NULL CHECK (decimals BETWEEN 0 AND 18),
  active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE funds (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  captain_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES captain_profiles(user_id),
  mode text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PAPER' CHECK (mode = 'PAPER'),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'FROZEN', 'COMPLETED')),
  name text NOT NULL,
  description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  cash_usdc numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cash_usdc >= 0),
  total_shares numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (total_shares >= 0),
  high_water_mark numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (high_water_mark > 0),
  peak_share_price numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (peak_share_price > 0),
  event_sequence bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_fund_per_captain ON funds(captain_id)
  WHERE status IN ('ACTIVE', 'FROZEN');

CREATE TABLE fund_policy_versions (
  fund_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES funds(id),
  version integer NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0),
  max_order_bps integer NOT NULL CHECK (max_order_bps BETWEEN 1 AND 10000),
  max_position_bps integer NOT NULL CHECK (max_position_bps BETWEEN 1 AND 10000),
  drawdown_breaker_bps integer NOT NULL CHECK (drawdown_breaker_bps BETWEEN 1 AND 10000),
  allowed_instruments text[] NOT NULL,
  effective_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (fund_id, version)
);

CREATE TABLE trials (
  fund_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES funds(id),
  starts_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  ends_at timestamptz NOT NULL CHECK (ends_at > starts_at),
  seed_usdc numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL CHECK (seed_usdc > 0),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'COMPLETED'))
);

CREATE TABLE fund_shares (
  fund_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES funds(id),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  shares numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (shares >= 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (fund_id, user_id)
);

CREATE TABLE positions (
  fund_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES funds(id),
  instrument_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES instruments(id),
  quantity numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (quantity >= 0),
  cost_basis_usdc numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (cost_basis_usdc >= 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (fund_id, instrument_id)
);

CREATE TABLE fund_events (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  fund_id uuid REFERENCES funds(id),
  sequence bigint,
  type text NOT NULL,
  payload jsonb NOT NULL,
  recorded_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (fund_id, sequence)
);

CREATE TABLE ledger_accounts (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  owner_type text NOT NULL CHECK (owner_type IN ('USER', 'FUND', 'MARKET', 'ISSUANCE', 'PROTOCOL')),
  owner_id text NOT NULL,
  asset_id text NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (owner_type, owner_id, asset_id)
);

CREATE TABLE ledger_entries (
  id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  event_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES fund_events(id),
  account_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_accounts(id),
  amount numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL CHECK (amount <> 0),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX ledger_entries_event_idx ON ledger_entries(event_id);

CREATE TABLE price_observations (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  instrument_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES instruments(id),
  source text NOT NULL,
  source_ref text,
  price_usdc numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL CHECK (price_usdc > 0),
  liquidity_usdc numeric(38, 18) CHECK (liquidity_usdc > 0),
  source_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  received_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX price_observations_latest_idx ON price_observations(instrument_id, source_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE orders (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  fund_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES funds(id),
  captain_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  idempotency_key text NOT NULL,
  side text NOT NULL CHECK (side IN ('BUY', 'SELL')),
  instrument_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES instruments(id),
  notional_usdc numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL CHECK (notional_usdc > 0),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'FILLED', 'PARTIALLY_FILLED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED')),
  reject_reason text,
  submitted_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  processed_at timestamptz,
  UNIQUE (captain_id, idempotency_key)
);

CREATE INDEX orders_pending_idx ON orders(submitted_at) WHERE status = 'PENDING';

CREATE TABLE fills (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  observation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES price_observations(id),
  quantity numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
  market_price_usdc numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL CHECK (market_price_usdc > 0),
  fill_price_usdc numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL CHECK (fill_price_usdc > 0),
  fee_usdc numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL CHECK (fee_usdc >= 0),
  model_version integer NOT NULL,
  filled_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE nav_snapshots (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  fund_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES funds(id),
  nav_usdc numeric(38, 18),
  share_price_usdc numeric(38, 18),
  status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('CURRENT', 'UNAVAILABLE')),
  priced_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX nav_snapshots_latest_idx ON nav_snapshots(fund_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE fee_assessments (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  fund_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES funds(id),
  fee_day date NOT NULL,
  fee_usdc numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL CHECK (fee_usdc >= 0),
  shares_minted numeric(38, 18) NOT NULL CHECK (shares_minted >= 0),
  event_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES fund_events(id),
  UNIQUE (fund_id, fee_day)
);

CREATE TABLE messages (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  fund_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES funds(id),
  author_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  body text NOT NULL,
  linked_order_id uuid REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE outbox_events (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  fund_event_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES fund_events(id),
  type text NOT NULL,
  payload jsonb NOT NULL,
  attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  next_attempt_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  delivered_at timestamptz
);

CREATE TABLE api_idempotency (
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  key text NOT NULL,
  route text NOT NULL,
  request_hash text NOT NULL,
  response jsonb,
  status_code integer,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, key)
);

ALTER TABLE nav_snapshots
ADD COLUMN observation_id uuid REFERENCES price_observations(id);

ALTER TABLE messages
  ADD COLUMN kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CHAT' CHECK (kind IN ('CHAT', 'TRADE_NOTE')),
  ADD COLUMN moderation_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'VISIBLE'
    CHECK (moderation_status IN ('VISIBLE', 'HIDDEN')),
  ADD COLUMN corrects_message_id uuid REFERENCES messages(id),
  ADD COLUMN event_sequence bigint,
  ADD CONSTRAINT messages_kind_link_check CHECK (
    (kind = 'CHAT' AND linked_order_id IS NULL AND corrects_message_id IS NULL)
    OR (kind = 'TRADE_NOTE' AND linked_order_id IS NOT NULL)
  ),
  ADD CONSTRAINT messages_fund_sequence_unique UNIQUE (fund_id, event_sequence);

CREATE INDEX messages_fund_cursor_idx ON messages(fund_id, event_sequence)
  WHERE moderation_status = 'VISIBLE';

ALTER TABLE funds
  ADD COLUMN protocol_shares numeric(38,18) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (protocol_shares >= 0),
  ADD COLUMN performance_fee_factor numeric(38,18) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (performance_fee_factor >= 1),
  ADD COLUMN final_nav_usdc numeric(38,18),
  ADD COLUMN final_share_price_usdc numeric(38,18);

ALTER TABLE nav_snapshots
  ADD COLUMN performance_fee_factor numeric(38,18) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (performance_fee_factor >= 1);

ALTER TABLE fee_assessments
  ADD COLUMN model_version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  ADD COLUMN pre_fee_share_price numeric(38,18),
  ADD COLUMN post_fee_share_price numeric(38,18),
  ADD COLUMN high_water_mark_before numeric(38,18),
  ADD COLUMN captain_shares numeric(38,18) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN protocol_shares numeric(38,18) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

ALTER TABLE captain_profiles
  ADD COLUMN avatar_url text,
  ADD COLUMN banner_url text,
  ADD CONSTRAINT captain_avatar_url_length CHECK (avatar_url IS NULL OR length(avatar_url) BETWEEN 1 AND 2048),
  ADD CONSTRAINT captain_banner_url_length CHECK (banner_url IS NULL OR length(banner_url) BETWEEN 1 AND 2048);

CREATE TABLE captain_asset_uploads (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  captain_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES captain_profiles(user_id),
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('avatar', 'banner')),
  content_type text NOT NULL CHECK (content_type IN ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp')),
  byte_size integer NOT NULL CHECK (byte_size BETWEEN 1 AND 5242880),
  staging_key text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'COMPLETED')),
  public_url text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now() + interval '10 minutes'),
  completed_at timestamptz,
  CHECK ((status='PENDING' AND public_url IS NULL AND completed_at IS NULL)
      OR (status='COMPLETED' AND public_url IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL))
);
CREATE INDEX captain_upload_rate ON captain_asset_uploads(captain_id,created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX captain_assets_owned_url ON captain_asset_uploads(captain_id,kind,public_url) WHERE status='COMPLETED';

-- Devnet token layer: only money in and out touches Solana devnet.
-- Trades, P&L, fees and captains stay in the paper ledger.

CREATE TABLE user_wallets (
  user_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id),
  address text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Transfers that the backend signs and sends. The intent row exists before the send.
-- A new signature replaces the old one only after the old one can no longer land.
CREATE TABLE token_payouts (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('SIGNUP_GRANT', 'WITHDRAWAL')),
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  wallet text NOT NULL,
  amount_raw bigint NOT NULL CHECK (amount_raw > 0),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')),
  signature text UNIQUE,
  wire_transaction text,
  last_valid_block_height bigint,
  attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_error text,
  event_id uuid REFERENCES fund_events(id),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_signup_grant_per_user ON token_payouts(user_id) WHERE kind = 'SIGNUP_GRANT';
CREATE INDEX token_payouts_pending_idx ON token_payouts(user_id) WHERE status = 'PENDING';

-- Transfers that a user signs and the client submits. A claim is per (signature, user),
-- so a stranger who posts a signature first cannot block its owner.
-- One signature can credit the paper ledger only once.
CREATE TABLE token_deposits (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  signature text NOT NULL,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  amount_raw bigint NOT NULL CHECK (amount_raw > 0),
  fund_id uuid REFERENCES funds(id),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'FAILED', 'EXPIRED')),
  failure text,
  event_id uuid REFERENCES fund_events(id),
  join_event_id uuid,
  join_error text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (signature, user_id)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_credit_per_signature ON token_deposits(signature) WHERE status = 'CONFIRMED';

-- A deposit claim expires only after the chain passes this block height (finalized). It is set
-- the first time the signature is missing on chain: the processed tip then, plus the blockhash
-- lifetime and a margin. No transaction that the cluster had not seen by then can land later.
ALTER TABLE token_deposits ADD COLUMN expiry_block_height bigint;

-- One receipt across both linked-wallet claims and external-wallet QR payments.
CREATE TABLE token_deposit_receipts (
  signature text PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
INSERT INTO token_deposit_receipts(signature, user_id)
SELECT signature, user_id FROM token_deposits WHERE status = 'CONFIRMED';

CREATE TABLE qr_deposits (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  reference text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  mint text NOT NULL,
  recipient text NOT NULL,
  treasury_ata text NOT NULL,
  amount_raw bigint NOT NULL CHECK (amount_raw >= 1000000 AND amount_raw <= 1000000000000),
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'WAITING' CHECK (status IN ('WAITING', 'CONFIRMING', 'CONFIRMED', 'EXPIRED')),
  credited_raw numeric(30,0) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  signature text,
  last_error text,
  scan_until text,
  scan_before text,
  scan_head text,
  next_scan_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now() + interval '30 minutes',
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX qr_deposits_user_idx ON qr_deposits(user_id, created_at DESC, id DESC);
CREATE INDEX qr_deposits_scan_idx ON qr_deposits(next_scan_at);

CREATE TABLE qr_deposit_attempts (
  deposit_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES qr_deposits(id),
  signature text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'REJECTED', 'CREDITED')),
  failure text,
  event_id uuid REFERENCES fund_events(id),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  last_checked_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT 'epoch',
  PRIMARY KEY (deposit_id, signature)
);

anchorAccounts.source:
pub struct Proposal {
    pub fund: Pubkey,
    pub id: u64,
    pub proposer: Pubkey,
    pub venue: Pubkey,
    pub input_mint: Pubkey,
    pub output_mint: Pubkey,
    pub amount_in: u64,
    pub min_out: u64,
    /// sha256(venue_data || per venue account: pubkey || is_signer || is_writable).
    /// The bytes stay off-chain; the executor passes the data and the venue
    /// accounts, and they must hash to this.
    pub route_hash: [u8; 32],
    pub created_at: i64,
    pub deadline: i64,
    pub total_shares_snapshot: u64,
    pub yes_weight: u64,
    pub no_weight: u64,
    pub status: ProposalStatus,
    pub bump: u8,
}

instructions.name: initialize_config
instructions.signature: pub fn initialize_config(ctx: Context<InitializeConfig>) -> Result<()>
instructions.checks: Signer equals ProgramData upgrade authority. USDC mint has 6 decimals. Becomes admin.

instructions.name: queue_token
instructions.signature:
pub fn queue_token(
        ctx: Context<QueueToken>,
        price_source: PriceSource,
        tier: Tier,
        decimals: u8,
    ) -> Result<()>
instructions.checks: `PriceSource`, tier (`T1`, `T2`, `T3`), decimals. Non-USDC mint has no freeze authority and no extension. ETA = now + 7 days.

instructions.name: apply_token
instructions.signature: pub fn apply_token(ctx: Context<ApplyToken>) -> Result<()>
instructions.checks: ETA passed. A new price source resets the Switchboard marks.

instructions.name: queue_venue
instructions.signature: pub fn queue_venue(ctx: Context<QueueVenue>, active: bool) -> Result<()>
instructions.checks: One `VenueEntry` PDA `[b"venue", program]` per venue, no count limit. `queue_venue(active)` sets the pending value, ETA = now + 7 days. Removal (`active = false`) is queued the same way. A new queue overwrites the pending change and restarts the clock.

instructions.name: apply_venue
instructions.signature: pub fn apply_venue(ctx: Context<ApplyVenue>) -> Result<()>
instructions.checks: One `VenueEntry` PDA `[b"venue", program]` per venue, no count limit. `queue_venue(active)` sets the pending value, ETA = now + 7 days. Removal (`active = false`) is queued the same way. A new queue overwrites the pending change and restarts the clock.

instructions.name: set_paused
instructions.signature: pub fn set_paused(ctx: Context<SetPaused>, paused: bool) -> Result<()>
instructions.checks: Immediate. Blocks `deposit`, `create_fund` and swaps whose output is not USDC. Never blocks `exit` or sales to USDC.

instructions.name: create_fund
instructions.signature:
pub fn create_fund(
        ctx: Context<CreateFund>,
        fund_id: u64,
        deposit: u64,
        open_seas: bool,
    ) -> Result<()>
instructions.checks: Deposit at least 250 USDC. Mints 1:1 shares. Creates policy, member, vaults and share mint (NonTransferable, PermanentDelegate). `open_seas` allows T3 buys; fixed at creation.

instructions.name: deposit
instructions.signature: pub fn deposit(ctx: Context<Deposit>, amount: u64, min_shares: u64) -> Result<()>
instructions.checks: Not paused, fund not closed, NAV (upper bound, T3 at no less than cost) nonzero. Price per share = max(fresh upper bound, recorded pps). `min_shares`: fewer shares fail (`SlippageExceeded`).

instructions.name: exit
instructions.signature: pub fn exit<'info>(ctx: Context<'info, Exit<'info>>, shares: u64) -> Result<()>
instructions.checks: Own share balance only. No pause, freeze or price check. Pro-rata of every holding. Fee on profit above HWM. With valid NAV accounts, a crew exit also pays first-loss compensation (see Open Seas). Captain must keep at least 5% of shares while others hold shares, and a stake worth the T3 basis left while T3 is held (fresh prices needed).

instructions.name: add_delegate
instructions.signature:
pub fn add_delegate(
        ctx: Context<AddDelegate>,
        key: Pubkey,
        max_trade_usd: u64,
        daily_volume_usd: u64,
    ) -> Result<()>
instructions.checks: Per-trade and daily USD limits. Revoke returns rent.

instructions.name: update_delegate
instructions.signature:
pub fn update_delegate(
        ctx: Context<UpdateDelegate>,
        max_trade_usd: u64,
        daily_volume_usd: u64,
    ) -> Result<()>
instructions.checks: Per-trade and daily USD limits. Revoke returns rent.

instructions.name: swap
instructions.signature:
pub fn swap<'info>(
        ctx: Context<'info, Swap<'info>>,
        amount_in: u64,
        min_out: u64,
        venue_data: Vec<u8>,
    ) -> Result<()>
instructions.checks: Venue, tiers, caps, delegate limits, breaker, price guard, vault balance deltas, vault sizes (`VaultResized`), share mint not in venue accounts, T3 rules (Open Seas). A trade above `autonomous_bps` of spot NAV, or above the fund's rolling 24 h budget of the same size, needs a proposal.

instructions.name: propose_trade
instructions.signature:
pub fn propose_trade<'info>(
        ctx: Context<'info, ProposeTrade<'info>>,
        amount_in: u64,
        min_out: u64,
        venue_data: Vec<u8>,
    ) -> Result<()>
instructions.checks: Stores `route_hash` and the trade terms. Opens the vote window from policy.

instructions.name: vote
instructions.signature: pub fn vote(ctx: Context<CastVote>, yes: bool) -> Result<()>
instructions.checks: One vote per member (VoteRecord `init`). Open proposal, before the deadline. Weight = share balance.

instructions.name: execute_proposal
instructions.signature:
pub fn execute_proposal<'info>(
        ctx: Context<'info, ExecuteProposal<'info>>,
